sentences.text: The names of the present applicants are not mentioned in the FIR.
Merely to harass the present applicants, the investigating agency is behind them to arrest them.

In fact, they have cooperated with the investigating agency, the food grains are already under the control of the Investigating Officer kept in the Warehouse of the Buldhana Urban Co-operative Society.
Thus, physical custody of the present applicants is not required and therefore, the ad-interim protection granted in their favour deserves to be confirmed.

4. Learned APP strongly opposed the application on the ground that during investigation, it revealed that the present applicants are the persons who have misappropriated the food grains which are obtained from the various agriculturists.
He submitted that the statements are recorded from which the involvement of the present applicants is  (3) 25.aba.732.2023 revealed.
In view of that, the anticipatory bail deserves to be rejected.
5. Having heard the learned Counsel for the applicants and learned APP for the State, perused the investigation papers.
During investigation the statements are recorded.
From the statements of the witnesses, it reveal that the applicants were not seen any time visiting the Godown.

Moreover, during the investigation, the present applicants have produced the stock verification register which shows that from time to time the authority has verified the stock and it is found correct.
Admittedly, after granting ad-interim protection the present applicants have attended the Police Station, whenever they are called for and cooperated with the investigating agency.

Considering the fact that, the food grains are already in the custody of the police, which are kept in Warehouse of the Buldhana Urban Co-operative Society and physical custody of the present applicants are not required for further Ganesh S/O. As far as the part of the interrogation is concerned, the condition of attending the Police Station can be imposed on the present applicants.
In view of that, interim protection granted to the present applicants deserves to be confirmed.
Accordingly, I proceed to pass following order.
ORDER (i) The application is allowed.

(ii) In the event of their arrest in connection with Crime No.0031/2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 409, 420,
468, 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, the applicant No.(1) Ganesh s/o Laxman Rathod, No.(2) Akash s/o Anil Deshmukh, No.(3) Ramesh s/o Vitthal Mule and No.(4) Onkar s/o Vinayak Patil be released on anticipatory bail on execution of PR bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/-
each with one solvent surety in the like amount.
(iii) The applicants shall attend Police Station once in a week on Monday between 10.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
(iv) The applicants shall not leave the jurisdiction of Washim District without prior permission of the Court.
(v) The applicants shall not induce, threat or promise any witnesses who acquainted with facts of the case.

(URMILA JOSHI-PHALKE, J.) Sarkate Signed by: Mr. A.R. Sarkate Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 20/02/2024 16:10:01 Ganesh S/O. Laxman Rathod And Others vs The State Of Mah. Thr. Pi, Economic ...
